note: Three roots per relative-time-card page. relative-time-card: the card's content, read on `.content` in our own shadow root. The prepare script removes the content of every CLOSED card first: ours slots that content in whether the card is open or shut, while the reference builds it only when open, so without the removal our side reports 6 roots against the reference's 4 and the diff pairs them by the wrong position. A hop selector cannot express this, because the content is slotted INTO the card rather than living inside it; a client-only state the sketch (tools/geist/sketch/relative-time-card.open.json) renders on the mirror and the census page opens through the prepare script (shown=1, disable-triggers on every card of the Open example; the docs page pins nothing). relative-time-label: the short age the element draws with nothing slotted (the Plain sketch), read on the slot's fallback span. Its prepare drops the label of every card that HAS something slotted, because those draw a button whose label the reference has no counterpart for: without it our side reads 6 roots against the reference's 1. relative-time-trigger: the composed context card's trigger wrapper around the slotted button or the label, read through the acme-context-card hop. Run each side with theme light and dark; width fixes every preview at the mirror's 600px stage. Text-bearing parts and the column they size are read as soft (textParts); the zone chips keep their height hard and their width soft (textProps), as it follows the abbreviation.
